_readme: Each section has 'enabled' plus a list of 'templates'.
If a section has more than one template, one is picked at random each time.
When PARSE_MODE=md, {mention} becomes a clickable @mention and names are
auto-escaped, so do not add * or _ around {first_name} unless you want bold/italic.
Leave the text empty ("") or set enabled:false to switch a section off.

templates: Hi {first_name}! 👋 Thanks for messaging. I've seen your message and I'll reply properly as soon as I'm free.
Hey {first_name}, thanks for reaching out! 🙌 I'm a bit tied up right now — I'll get back to you shortly.
Hello {first_name}! Got your message. I'll respond as soon as possible. 🙂
Welcome to Telegram, {first_name}! 🎉 Great to see you here. Ping me anytime.
Hey {first_name}, you finally joined Telegram! 😄 Message me whenever you're free.
Welcome to {chat_name}, {mention}! 👋 Glad to have you here.
Hi {mention}, welcome aboard! 🎉 Say hello and introduce yourself.
